name: Create Task Comment
description: Adds a comment to a task. [See the documentation](https://developers.asana.com/docs/create-a-story-on-a-task)

configurable_props.name: project
configurable_props.label: Project
configurable_props.description: List of projects. This field uses the project GID.

configurable_props.name: task_gid
configurable_props.label: Task GID
configurable_props.description: The task GID to operate on.

configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: Text
configurable_props.description: The plain text of the comment to add. Cannot be used with html_text.

configurable_props.name: html_text
configurable_props.label: HTML Text
configurable_props.description: HTML formatted text for a comment. This will not include the name of the creator.

configurable_props.name: is_pinned
configurable_props.label: Is Pinned
configurable_props.description: Conditional. Whether the story should be pinned on the resource.

configurable_props.name: sticker_name
configurable_props.label: Sticker Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the sticker in this story. null if there is no sticker.
